pr_title: Dismiss any open content dialog when window is moved
pr_body:
## Summary of the Pull Request
When the window moves, hide any visible content dialog (only one can be shown at a time) and ensure its associated async operation is terminated.

#10922 dismisses any open popups when the window is moved or any scroll viewer scrolls. However, if you just close a Popup from the UI tree, the async operation associated to a ContentDialog (started with `dialog.ShowAsync`) does not terminate. The dialog lock that prevents opening multiple dialogs at the same time is not released, and no further dialog can be shown. 
Explicitly dismissing the only visible ContentDialog using its `Hide` method terminates the operation.

## Validation Steps Performed
Manual tests, open up dialogs and move the window (like in #11425)

References #10922 
Closes #11425

issue_context.title: Moving the window after opening a dialog will make the window weird
issue_context.body:
_found in 1.12.2781.0 Bug Bash on 10/5/2021_


REPRO:
	1. Open the Terminal
	2. Edit the json so it's invalid (delete a comma in the settings)
	3. Move the window, so the warning dialog dismisses itself.
	4. Edit the settings again. Leave it invalid. Add a newline
	5. Notice, no dialog (ooooooooooh)
    6. Now try to close the window, that won't work


This certainly regressed when I added support for dismissing that dialog when the window moved.
comments: I'm surprised that programmatically dismissing the dialog doesn't terminate the `Show` :(
I think its because it get dismissed as a popup, not as a ContentDialog and the problem is upstream. What do you think?
